description: This file defines a fake content repository implementation for a streaming app, providing mock data and methods to fetch content, search, and track playback progress.

classes.name: FakeContentRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ContentRepository that provides preset content data and simulates asynchronous data fetching.

methods.name: _library
methods.description: Returns a fixed list of ContentItem objects representing sample content.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Simulates fetching a home feed with shuffled content rails after a delay.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search in the content library based on query string.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentItem by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgress
methods.description: Mock method to record playback position; operates as a no-op.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Mock method to record completion of playback; operates as a no-op.

methods.name: getPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Returns null indicating no stored playback progress.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Returns an empty list, simulating no watch history.
